title: Approximate tangent planes of a set carried by a C¹ submanifold lie in its tangent spaces
statement: Let P, n, r, d ∈ ℕ with r ≥ 1, and let N be an embedded C^r d-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d N). Let M ⊆ ℝ^P with Hⁿ(M ∖ N) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n], and let x ∈ N. Let Q be an approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q): finrank Q = n, and ∫_{η_{x,λ}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as λ ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), where η_{x,λ}(y) = λ⁻¹(y − x). Then Q ⊆ T_xN = tangentSpace N x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n r d : ℕ) (M N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ r → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d N → x ∈ N → μHE[n] (M \ N) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ⊆ tangentSpace N x
